name: flowmaps
description: Plan your app with Flowmaps: see your ventures and what's ready to build, add ideas to your mind map, and read the build plan for a feature.

interface.shortDescription: Plan your app in build order
interface.longDescription: Flowmaps is a visual app planner for anyone building with AI. Each business idea gets one mind map and one board, with every feature in build order and a build plan per feature. Here you can see your ventures and the features that are Ready, add new ideas to a mind map (with automatic review flags for legal, security, compliance and cost risks), and read or explain the build plan for a feature. This is for planning: building happens in a coding tool in your own project.
interface.defaultPrompt: What can I build from Flowmaps?

positive.prompt: What can I build from Flowmaps?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the venture Pawstep and its 2 features that are Ready to build: Set up the project (v0.1.0) and Owners sign up and log in (v0.2.0), with links to Flowmaps.

positive.prompt: Which features are ready in Pawstep?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Set up the project and Owners sign up and log in as Ready, with their version numbers.

positive.prompt: Explain the build plan for Owners sign up and log in in Flowmaps.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the feature's build plan (its database, backend and frontend parts) in plain words, without changing anything.

positive.description: Add an idea to a mind map
positive.prompt: Add 'Walkers can set their availability' as an idea to my Pawstep mind map in Flowmaps.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation if needed, adds the card to Pawstep's mind map and replies with a link to it.

positive.description: An idea that gets a review flag
positive.prompt: Add an idea to Pawstep in Flowmaps: owners pay with a saved credit card.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the card and mentions the automatic security review flag, noting that flags are not legal advice.
